4. Craft 1 magenta bed using 3 magenta wool and 3 planks.

7. I will now craft 1 white dye. This requires 1 bone meal.
8. I still need to craft 1 white wool. For that, I need 4 strands of string.
9. Craft 1 blue wool. This requires 1 blue dye + 1 white wool.
10. Make the blue dye from the 1 wither rose.
11. To craft 4 white wool, I now need 4 string, which I will make from 4 cotton strings.
12. Use the 4 cotton strings to create the 4 white wool from the white wool recipe.
13. Lastly, craft 3 gray dye from 1 black dye and 1 white dye.
14. Obtain 1 gray dye. Combine it with the white dye to make one gray dye.
15. Now I need 1 white bed for the gray bed crafting recipe, so I craft that using the existing white bed (from the steps above) and the gray dye.

- Combining 1 gray dye and 1 blue dye to make one gray dye
- Crafting 3 gray wool: 
   1. Create 1 gray wool from 1 gray dye + 1 white wool
   2. Create 3 white wool
- Using these 3 white wool to craft 1 white bed
- And combining them to make 3 gray wool needed for crafting the final gray bed

Finally, craft the gray bed using 3 gray wool and 3 planks.

10. Craft 1 gray bed (need 3 gray wool, 3 planks).
